title: Create 8-10 default palette JSON files
description: Create 8-10 well-designed color palette JSON files in config/palettes/. Each palette is a complete set of all 22 CSS custom property tokens. Palettes should be harmonious, professional, and suitable for service business websites.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 8 palette JSON files exist in `config/palettes/`
Each file contains all 22 CSS custom property tokens
All palettes have unique IDs and descriptive names
Palette colors have sufficient contrast ratios (text on backgrounds pass WCAG AA)
Palettes cover a range of color schemes (blue, green, red, neutral, warm, cool, etc.)

steps.details: Primary: #2563eb (blue). Create complete 22-token palette. Save to `config/palettes/ocean-blue.json`.
Primary: #334155 (dark slate). Accent: #f59e0b. Professional neutral look. Save to `config/palettes/slate-professional.json`.
Primary: #dc2626 (red). Suitable for emergency/urgent services. Save to `config/palettes/crimson-bold.json`.
Primary: #d97706 (amber/orange). Suitable for construction, trades. Save to `config/palettes/amber-trade.json`.
Primary: #4f46e5 (indigo/purple). Modern professional look. Save to `config/palettes/indigo-modern.json`.
Primary: #0d9488 (teal). Clean, trustworthy look. Save to `config/palettes/teal-clean.json`.
Primary: #1f2937 (charcoal). Minimal, high-end look with white/light backgrounds. Save to `config/palettes/charcoal-minimal.json`.
Call `listPalettes()` and verify all 8 palettes are returned. For each palette, verify all 22 tokens are present. Switch between palettes in the preview and verify each one applies correctly.

technicalNotes: For each palette: primary-hover should be 10% darker than primary. primary-light should be a very light tint (90% lighter). primary-dark should be 20% darker.
Background is typically #ffffff, surface is slightly off-white (#f8fafc), surface-alt is slightly darker (#f1f5f9).
Text-primary is near-black, text-secondary is medium gray, text-inverted is white.
Ensure --color-overlay is always `rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` or similar dark transparent — it's used for hero image overlays.
